newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 23.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Second Earth Summit opens in New-York today in a context of conflict between Europeans and Americans on environmental issues and notably on countries' responsibility in global warming phenomena.

-- Aerospatiale chairman Yves Michot is quoted as saying a planned alliance with Dassault is not put in doubt by the new Socialist-led government, and its defence electronics restructuring in partnership with Alcatel-Alsthom remains on the agenda.
-- Gec -Alsthom to reshuffle organisation, increase decentralisation.
